value.rationale: The complete centered exponential-moment envelope is a motivated sharp quantity for graph concentration and optimal Chernoff bounds under Cartesian tensor powers, strictly finer than maximal Lipschitz variance. The exact staircase of floor(n/2)-1 leaf-sign optimizer switches provides a non-obvious structural classification across an infinite family, with a new explicit limiting optimizer density and limit envelope. It quantifies how a branching hub alters extremal rare-event geometry; this is not a routine substitution into a known path formula, and the precise threshold count has motivated downstream use for tilt-dependent concentration bounds.
